**Audio Studio MCP 1.1.1 fixes cases where an install from PyPI (uvx) could stay stuck on "run setup".** No breaking changes, and the license is unchanged (MIT). Update with `uv cache clean audio-studio-mcp`, then run setup again.

[🎧 Listen to samples](https://kanaworksai-hue.github.io/audio-studio-mcp/) · [English](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp#readme) · [简体中文](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [日本語](https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp/blob/main/README.ja.md)

## Fixes

- **Cleared Hugging Face cache (macOS).** If the model files had been removed from the Hugging Face cache, `setup` reported "Ready" without downloading them again, and every tool call kept asking for setup. Setup now downloads them again, and it reports an error instead of "Ready" if a file is still missing.
- **The setup command in error messages matches the server.** When a client runs the server with a small model (`AUDIO_STUDIO_SA3_MODEL=sm-music` / `sm-sfx`), the "weights are not downloaded yet" message now says `setup --model sm-…`. Before, it gave the plain command, which downloads the medium model. If the client sets `AUDIO_STUDIO_HOME`, `HF_HOME` or `HF_HUB_CACHE`, the message also says to use the same values in the terminal.
- **Model files already in the Hugging Face cache are linked automatically (macOS).** The server now links them itself, so a future update that changes the Stable Audio 3 runtime won't ask you to run setup again.
- **A relative `AUDIO_STUDIO_HOME`** (for example `AUDIO_STUDIO_HOME=home`) no longer crashes the server. It is resolved against the folder where the server was started.
- **Runtime download is more robust.** An incomplete runtime folder (for example a file deleted or quarantined by antivirus) is replaced instead of failing every time. A damaged or unexpected download, or a folder that can't be moved into place, gives a readable error that says what to do, not a traceback. Archive entries with Windows path separators or drive letters are ignored, and the archive must name the pinned upstream commit.

## Docs

- The README (English, 日本語, 简体中文):
  - says where generated files go with uvx (`~/AudioStudio`)
  - shows how to get the small models with setup (`--model sm-music`, `sm-sfx`, `all`)
  - fixes the `%LOCALAPPDATA%` path and the macOS model size (~6.9 GB including the text encoder, also in `install.sh`)
  - gives realistic download sizes for AI agents (about 7 GB on macOS, 13 GB on Windows)
  - corrects the wheel smoke-test commands for developers
- The GitHub release notes of v1.1.0 now list the license note first.

## Development

- `scripts/smoke_test.py --server` now works with quoted Windows paths.
- The release workflow can be re-run after a failed MCP Registry step: the PyPI upload skips files that already exist.
- The `--python` hint in `server.json` is worded correctly.
